claims.title: The pilot found reload faster at every sampled prefix, without locating a crossover length.
claims.numbers: 18/18 reload-path median comparisons favor reload; prefixes 512, 2048, 8192; turns 32 and 256; 12 repeats per cell.
claims.scope: Kaggle T4; Qwen2.5-1.5B; repeated text; pinned, pageable and file paths.
claims.caveat: Median ordering is descriptive; the pilot does not establish a universal crossover length.

claims.title: The pilot prefix-only bandwidth threshold is measured, not assumed.
claims.scope: Pilot T4, Qwen2.5-1.5B; prefix-only threshold, independent of later TTFT adjustment.
claims.caveat: These values do not include returning-turn or fixed costs.

claims.title: The redesigned T4 data cover seven fp16 models with no invalid accepted sweep timings.
claims.numbers: 26040 accepted timings; 0 invalid; 7 measured model configurations; 10 full sweep sessions.
claims.scope: T4; prefixes and new-turn coverage are enumerated per run in the phase-two report.
claims.caveat: Native context and budget exclusions prevent a balanced full grid.

claims.title: Verified KV size differs substantially across the measured attention layouts.
claims.numbers: pythia-1.4b = 196608 bytes/token; Qwen2.5-0.5B = 12288 bytes/token; Qwen2.5-1.5B = 28672 bytes/token; Qwen2.5-3B = 36864 bytes/token; opt-1.3b = 196608 bytes/token; phi-2 = 327680 bytes/token; Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct = 114688 bytes/token
claims.scope: Seven fp16 model configurations on T4; the five transfer models match their cache tensors on Modal.
claims.caveat: Models also differ in size and kernels; this is not an isolated GQA/MHA architecture intervention.

claims.title: Adding the resident-turn baseline improves descriptive T4 rule agreement.
claims.numbers: TTFT-adjusted 1237/1258; prefix-only 1017/1258 resolved simulated-rate decisions.
claims.scope: T4, seven models and observed lengths; all simulated rates; same-session measured baselines.
claims.caveat: This is descriptive agreement, not preregistered hardware transfer or independent Bernoulli trials.

claims.title: Returning-turn and fixed costs can dominate a small KV footprint.
claims.numbers: Qwen2.5-0.5B at L=512, N=32: prefix-only B* 226.626 MB/s; adjusted B* 2442.265 MB/s; observed [1600.0, unthrottled] target / [1558.1, 9531.0] achieved MB/s.
claims.scope: T4, Qwen2.5-0.5B repeated-text control.
claims.caveat: Use B* = KV_bytes / (T_recompute - T_GPU_hit - fixed_overhead - other_CPU_and_transfer_legs), only for a positive denominator. Count read, deserialization and H2D costs once; the prefix-only formula is insufficient here.

claims.title: The selected MHA controls require higher simulated bandwidth than the selected GQA controls.
claims.numbers: Qwen2.5-1.5B: [200.0, 400.0] target / [199.5, 398.4] achieved MB/s; Qwen2.5-3B: [100.0, 200.0] target / [99.9, 199.7] achieved MB/s; pythia-1.4b: [800.0, 1600.0] target / [798.9, 1597.2] achieved (median only) MB/s; phi-2: [800.0, 1600.0] target / [799.2, 1598.4] achieved MB/s
claims.scope: T4 repeated text, prefix 512 and new turn 32; Qwen2.5-1.5B/3B versus Pythia-1.4B and Phi-2.
claims.caveat: Descriptive model comparison. Model size, prefill kernels and cache layout all differ; this does not isolate the causal effect of GQA.

claims.title: A fixed first-session T4 calibration predicts later main-model sessions reasonably well.
claims.numbers: phase2-main-session-2: 148/149 correct, median relative TTFT error 2.954%; phase2-main-session-3: 146/150 correct, median relative TTFT error 1.714%
claims.scope: T4; Qwen2.5-1.5B UltraChat; common grid; calibration stays fixed.
claims.caveat: Same hardware type and input; no claim about unseen GPU types.

claims.title: Frozen calibration transfers to most resolved cells on each observed board.
claims.numbers: L4 (PCIe 3 x16): 574/636 correct, 13 unresolved, median absolute TTFT error 3.203 ms; A10 (PCIe 4 x16): 192/206 correct, 14 unresolved, median absolute TTFT error 2.040 ms; A10G (PCIe 4 x8): 398/426 correct, 3 unresolved, median absolute TTFT error 5.758 ms; H100 (PCIe 5 x16): 20/21 correct, 1 unresolved, median absolute TTFT error 6.579 ms
claims.scope: L4: main and four control models; A10: main only; A10G: main and four controls; H100: complete main-model cells only.
claims.caveat: Coverage differs across boards. H100 is partial. Unresolved paired intervals are excluded from decision accuracy.

claims.title: Short calibration does not reliably extrapolate TTFT to the largest native contexts.
claims.numbers: A10G (PCIe 4 x8), Qwen2.5-3B, L=32736, N=32, recompute: predicted 8041.096 vs observed 13914.555 ms, absolute error 5873.459 ms; L4 (PCIe 3 x16), Qwen2.5-3B, L=32736, N=32, recompute: predicted 13088.360 vs observed 18022.902 ms, absolute error 4934.542 ms; L4 (PCIe 3 x16), Qwen2.5-3B, L=32736, N=32, prefix_only: predicted 13980.511 vs observed 9148.164 ms, absolute error 4832.347 ms
claims.scope: Observed Qwen2.5-3B native-limit extrapolation on L4 and A10G.
claims.caveat: Median errors conceal these tails; a low median cannot justify universal long-context prediction.

claims.title: Exact proportional scaling of crossover bandwidth with prefill throughput is not established.
claims.numbers: L4 (PCIe 3 x16): 25/27 ratio-resolved shapes compatible with at least one matched T4 bracket; 32 not ratio-resolved; A10 (PCIe 4 x16): 11/12 ratio-resolved shapes compatible with at least one matched T4 bracket; 8 not ratio-resolved; A10G (PCIe 4 x8): 20/24 ratio-resolved shapes compatible with at least one matched T4 bracket; 15 not ratio-resolved; H100 (PCIe 5 x16): 0/1 ratio-resolved shapes compatible with at least one matched T4 bracket; 1 not ratio-resolved
claims.scope: Five transfer models where complete simulated-rate shapes and matched T4 observations exist.
claims.caveat: Compatibility is a broad-bracket test using frozen calibration throughput, not an equality test. Fixed overhead, new-turn cost and extrapolation error matter.

claims.title: At a matched main-model context, the faster GPU allocations shift crossover bandwidth upward.
claims.numbers: T4 / phase2-main-session-1: [100.0, 200.0] target / [100.0, 199.8] achieved MB/s; prefill 5581.6 tokens/s; T4 / phase2-main-session-2: [200.0, 400.0] target / [199.8, 399.0] achieved (median only) MB/s; prefill 6285.1 tokens/s; T4 / phase2-main-session-3: [200.0, 400.0] target / [199.7, 399.0] achieved MB/s; prefill 6469.7 tokens/s; A10 (PCIe 4 x16) / phase3-a10-main-1: [800.0, 1600.0] target / [795.2, 1544.2] achieved MB/s; prefill 18391.1 tokens/s; A10G (PCIe 4 x8) / phase3-a10-main-2: [400.0, 800.0] target / [396.2, 791.0] achieved MB/s; prefill 14178.2 tokens/s; H100 (PCIe 5 x16) / phase3-h100-main: above tested achieved rates (bound only) MB/s; prefill 73677.8 tokens/s; L4 (PCIe 3 x16) / phase3-l4-main-1: [800.0, 1600.0] target / [787.2, 1539.1] achieved MB/s; prefill 15213.0 tokens/s; L4 (PCIe 3 x16) / phase3-l4-main-2: [800.0, 1600.0] target / [788.6, 1552.0] achieved (median only) MB/s; prefill 14438.4 tokens/s
claims.scope: Qwen2.5-1.5B, UltraChat, L=1024, N=32; T4, L4, A10, A10G, H100.
claims.caveat: Only adjacent simulated-rate brackets or censored bounds are observed; host and driver also change. This is an allocation comparison, not isolated GPU causality.

claims.title: L4 extends the sampled short-context recompute-favored regime relative to T4.
claims.numbers: L4 (PCIe 3 x16) / phase3-l4-main-1: recompute [16, 64, 128, 256], reload [], unresolved []; L4 (PCIe 3 x16) / phase3-l4-main-2: recompute [16, 64, 128, 256], reload [], unresolved []; A10 (PCIe 4 x16) / phase3-a10-main-1: recompute [16, 64, 128], reload [], unresolved [256]; A10G (PCIe 4 x8) / phase3-a10-main-2: recompute [16, 64, 128], reload [256], unresolved []; T4 / phase2-main-session-1: recompute [16, 64, 128], reload [256], unresolved []; T4 / phase2-main-session-2: recompute [16, 64, 128], reload [256], unresolved []; T4 / phase2-main-session-3: recompute [16], reload [256], unresolved [64, 128]
claims.scope: Qwen2.5-1.5B UltraChat, prefixes 16, 64, 128, 256, new turn 32; real unthrottled pinned path.
claims.caveat: No continuous crossover length is identified. A10 and A10G have separate allocations and boundaries.

claims.title: Session variability remains larger than some within-session intervals.
claims.numbers: T4, N=32: median 12.341%, maximum 17.332%; T4, N=256: median 14.847%, maximum 20.958%; L4, N=32: median 4.956%, maximum 8.755%; L4, N=256: median 4.417%, maximum 7.338%; L4 example L=8192, N=32: phase3-l4-main-1: 760.407 ms, within-session 95% CI [759.673, 766.897]; phase3-l4-main-2: 814.803 ms, within-session 95% CI [811.700, 820.760]
claims.scope: Main UltraChat model; three T4 sessions and two L4 sessions, all measured lengths, recompute.
claims.caveat: Range over median is descriptive; small session counts do not estimate a population confidence interval.

claims.title: The earlier A10 service-tier spread compares different boards and PCIe widths.
claims.numbers: A10: PCIe 4 x16, one main session; A10G: PCIe 4 x8, one main session; N=32: median matched-cell relative range 23.611%; N=256: median matched-cell relative range 22.664%
claims.scope: Matched Qwen2.5-1.5B UltraChat cells on A10 and A10G.
claims.caveat: Different board/PCIe allocations are the likely source of this service-tier difference. Causal attribution is unproved; host changes are confounded, and each board has only one main session.

claims.title: Kaggle file counters report physical reads.
claims.numbers: 7762/7762 recorded file observations have positive physical_read_bytes; byte-counter range 196608 to 1879052288.
claims.scope: Kaggle T4, all recorded phase-two file measurements and microbenchmarks, including calibration.
claims.caveat: These are process I/O counters, not physical-device traces. Page-cache-only interpretation is contradicted; underlying device and host cache remain unidentified.

claims.title: Modal file counters do not report physical reads.
claims.numbers: 0/4575 recorded file observations have positive physical_read_bytes; byte-counter range 0 to 0.
claims.scope: L4, A10, A10G, and the recovered H100 observations; file measurements and microbenchmarks.
claims.caveat: Use local file API path (page-cache resident; physical reads not observed). Page-cache residency is the operational interpretation of zero counters, not proof of the underlying host storage state.

claims.title: MHA file-path outcomes do not transfer uniformly from T4 to A10G.
claims.numbers: T4, pythia-1.4b, file_raw_staged: 0/4 reload wins, 0 unresolved; T4, pythia-1.4b, file_torch_direct: 0/4 reload wins, 0 unresolved; T4, phi-2, file_raw_staged: 0/1 reload wins, 3 unresolved; T4, phi-2, file_torch_direct: 2/3 reload wins, 1 unresolved; L4 (PCIe 3 x16), pythia-1.4b, file_raw_staged: 0/4 reload wins, 0 unresolved; L4 (PCIe 3 x16), pythia-1.4b, file_torch_direct: 0/4 reload wins, 0 unresolved; L4 (PCIe 3 x16), phi-2, file_raw_staged: 0/4 reload wins, 0 unresolved; L4 (PCIe 3 x16), phi-2, file_torch_direct: 0/4 reload wins, 0 unresolved; A10G (PCIe 4 x8), pythia-1.4b, file_raw_staged: 0/4 reload wins, 0 unresolved; A10G (PCIe 4 x8), pythia-1.4b, file_torch_direct: 1/4 reload wins, 0 unresolved; A10G (PCIe 4 x8), phi-2, file_raw_staged: 3/4 reload wins, 0 unresolved; A10G (PCIe 4 x8), phi-2, file_torch_direct: 3/4 reload wins, 0 unresolved
claims.scope: Pythia-1.4B and Phi-2 repeated text; matched prefixes 64, 256, 512, 1024, new turn 32; T4, L4 and A10G. A10 x16 has no MHA sweep.
claims.caveat: Phi-2 already has direct-file wins on T4, so a blanket claim that all MHA file paths lose there is false. Host file paths and read-counter behavior differ, so changes cannot be attributed to GPU speed alone. No MHA performance claim is available for A10 x16 or H100.

claims.title: Including deserialization improves the descriptive torch-file rule residual on T4.
claims.numbers: Torch median absolute relative error 11.780% to 3.097%; raw-format error 3.107% to 3.086%.
claims.scope: T4, seven models, full observed file cells; independently measured CPU legs and same-session baselines.
claims.caveat: The raw path barely changes. This is descriptive residual analysis, not frozen cross-GPU validation.

claims.title: The H100 point is incomplete and cannot validate the full fast-GPU or MHA hypothesis.
claims.numbers: 26 complete timing cells; 52 unfinished registered cells; complete main-model prefixes [1024, 16384]; Pythia sweep timings 0.
claims.scope: One H100 allocation; Qwen2.5-1.5B UltraChat complete cells only.
claims.caveat: Provider cancellation signal; initiating actor unknown; no second allocation. Partial cells are retained but excluded from scoring.

claims.title: The pilot prefill reversal has no established cause and did not repeat as a resolved reversal.
claims.numbers: 0/4 phase-two anomaly comparisons have a positive prefix-only-minus-prefix-plus-turn interval lower endpoint.
claims.scope: Qwen2.5-1.5B at prefix 8192 on repeated text and UltraChat; observed turn sizes.
claims.caveat: Non-reproduction does not identify the historical cause.

claims.title: Production-serving, concurrency, quantization and P100 conclusions are not supported.
claims.numbers: Successful recorded production-status observations: 0; accepted full sweep timings use concurrency [1]; dtypes ['float16'].
claims.scope: Reference Hugging Face path only; allocated T4, L4, A10, A10G and partial H100.
claims.caveat: No measured vLLM/LMCache speedup, P100 transfer, multi-request scaling, 4-bit model comparison or bf16 claim.

claims.title: A novelty claim for the basic reload-versus-recompute idea is not supported.
claims.numbers: No novelty claim is made for KV reuse, cache offload or choosing compute versus load.
claims.scope: Novelty boundary, not a measured performance effect.
claims.caveat: The permissible angle is this bounded older/commodity-GPU experiment, the calibrated rule and its measured transfer limits.
